source.test: rules.body-effect-evidence exposes the final body writer

steps.title: 填写request Breakpoint规则的名称和Host / Enter the request Breakpoint Rule name and Host
为request规则选择Breakpoint动作 / Choose Breakpoint for the request Rule
启用request Breakpoint规则 / Enable the request Breakpoint Rule
查看Breakpoint修改后的请求Final / Inspect the request Final after the Breakpoint edit
切换到Breakpoint请求的Original / Switch to the Breakpoint request Original
从正文标记返回最终写入规则 / Return from the body marker to the final writer Rule
填写request Body规则名称 / Enter the request Body Rule name
填写request Body规则Host / Enter the request Body Rule Host
为request规则选择Body动作 / Choose Body for the request Rule
核对Body的request阶段 / Check the Body request phase
填写request Body替换正文 / Enter the request Body replacement
启用request Body规则 / Enable the request Body Rule
保存request Body规则 / Save the request Body Rule
查看普通请求Body规则的Final / Inspect Final from the regular request Body Rule
选择普通Body的original版本 / Select the regular Body original version
查看普通Body original的Raw正文 / Inspect Raw for the regular Body original
复制普通Body original正文 / Copy the regular Body original
全屏查看普通Body original / Inspect the regular Body original fullscreen
从全屏复制普通Body original / Copy the regular Body original from fullscreen
关闭全屏后保留original与Raw / Retain original and Raw after closing fullscreen
选择本次文件位置 / Choose this operation’s file location
保存body-effect-regular-request-original.json后保留original正文 / Retain the original body after saving body-effect-regular-request-original.json
选择普通Body的final版本 / Select the regular Body final version
复制普通Body final正文 / Copy the regular Body final
全屏查看普通Body final / Inspect the regular Body final fullscreen
从全屏复制普通Body final / Copy the regular Body final from fullscreen
关闭全屏后保留final与Raw / Retain final and Raw after closing fullscreen
选择本次文件位置 / Choose this operation’s file location
保存body-effect-regular-request-final.json后保留final正文 / Retain the final body after saving body-effect-regular-request-final.json
点击普通Body来源前核对标记 / Inspect the regular Body source marker before following it
普通Body来源返回同一Rule身份 / The regular Body source returns to the same Rule identity
保存规则的停用状态 / Save the Rule's disabled state
填写response Body规则名称 / Enter the response Body Rule name
填写response Body规则Host / Enter the response Body Rule Host
为response规则选择Body动作 / Choose Body for the response Rule
核对Body的response阶段 / Check the Body response phase
填写response Body替换正文 / Enter the response Body replacement
启用response Body规则 / Enable the response Body Rule
保存response Body规则 / Save the response Body Rule
中文：Response Text Rule保留Final，并明确禁用不可观测的Original。 / English: A Response Text Rule keeps Final while explicitly disabling the unobservable Original.
查看普通Body final的Raw正文 / Inspect Raw for the regular Body final
复制普通Body final正文 / Copy the regular Body final
全屏查看普通Body final / Inspect the regular Body final fullscreen
从全屏复制普通Body final / Copy the regular Body final from fullscreen
关闭全屏后保留final与Raw / Retain final and Raw after closing fullscreen
选择本次文件位置 / Choose this operation’s file location
保存body-effect-regular-response-final.json后保留final正文 / Retain the final body after saving body-effect-regular-response-final.json
点击普通Body来源前核对标记 / Inspect the regular Body source marker before following it
普通Body来源返回同一Rule身份 / The regular Body source returns to the same Rule identity
选中用于保存的响应正文 / Select the response body to save
选择本次文件位置 / Choose this operation’s file location
为Breakpoint选择响应阶段 / Select response phase for the Breakpoint
中文：Capture只公开File来源和Final，绝不泄漏绝对路径或伪造Response Original。 / English: Capture exposes only File source and Final, never an absolute path or fabricated Response Original.
